angle: ROBUST PLANNER. Maximise the expected PRIVATE score (71% of the test, unseen embryos) with high confidence, and never give back public. Order of work: (1) protect the private score against the runtime cliff (x138 repairs sequentially after all GPU shards; any dataset that starts after REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=27000 s loses relink/readmit/gaps/safe divisions/linefit, ~-0.05..-0.065 per dataset; exp57b's DaughterNet insertion is not gated by that deadline); (2) lock the best base (x138, pending #34) with a pre-registered branch table; (3) stack only riders whose sign survives the value skeptics and that do not add nodes: C01 runtime rider, C05 lowrefine, C04 forkmid, insertion only when #35 >= #34; (4) spend LB slots on calibration and no-harm checks, not on public knob hunting (deterministic kernels, one public embryo); (5) finals: F1 = runtime-proven x138 stack that is NOT byte-identical to x138 (the 241-team 0.953 copy block straddles both medal cutoffs; a late verbatim copy ranks at its end), F2 = a structurally different, guard-free hedge (exp52). Two facts drive the design. First, a scored file's private score is fixed by the same hidden run as its public score, so runtime insurance only helps FUTURE builds, and latency <= REPAIR_DEADLINE_S PROVES a file was not degraded (runtime <= latency); that is a free per-file eligibility gate. Second, exp51 (same GPU phase, heavier dummy tail 1,713 s vs exp57b 1,367 s, ungated DaughterNet, no guard) scored within <= 7.5 h, so x138 verbatim is very likely undegraded and exp57b is borderline; the parallel-repair rebuild (N1) is triggered only if tonight's latencies say so. Honest: 0.99 is not reachable (0.015 above the LB #1); realistic end state is public ~0.954, private = x138's private level + ~0.001, with the main value being a positive private sign vs the x138 block and the absence of a runtime disaster.
outlook: F1 expected end state (guesses, anchored on files): PUBLIC 0.954 (80% interval 0.953-0.956) = x138 0.953 (#34, P~0.9 it reproduces exactly; browser s.6.0B counts identical) + DaughterNet insertion 0..+0.001 (our base: +0.001, RESULTS l.61) + forkmid ~+0.0005 (C04 MC mean) + lowrefine ~+0.0002 (invisible) + tempfuse only if it shows >= +0.002 (P 0.10-0.15). PRIVATE: x138's own private level + ~+0.001 (80%: -0.001..+0.003); P(private(F1) > private(x138 copies)) ~0.7 (riders keep nodes, C05/C04 have P(<0) ~0.2 each, insertion is dropped unless #35 >= #34). Runtime insurance (C01, N1 on trigger) protects against a ~0.01-0.03 private loss in the ~5-15% world where the hidden run is slower than exp51's (s_critic sim; s_verify_n1 bounds it to ~0.03-0.05 for C01 builds). The ABSOLUTE private level is dominated by the unknown private embryos (public = one embryo; guess: private level ~ public level +- 0.008 sd), not by our levers. Probabilities for F1 (guesses): public >= 0.955: 0.30; >= 0.96: 0.02; >= 0.97: < 0.005; >= 0.99: ~0. Private >= 0.955: ~0.40; >= 0.96: ~0.15; >= 0.97: ~0.02; >= 0.99: < 0.001 (private tail mass comes from embryo-level uncertainty, not from our work; relative to x138 we add +0.000..+0.002). Rank (guess, browser s.6.0C histogram): public ~#100-165 at 0.954-0.955; private ~#166-200 (silver edge, top 5% = ~195 of 3,899) if F1 beats the 241-copy x138 block by epsilon, ~#406-450 if it falls just below it. 0.99: unreachable by 29 Sep and above the LB top (0.975). It would need adjusted edge ~0.95+ and division J >= 0.4 on unseen embryos, i.e. new detection/localisation models trained with dense/external labels (Zebrahub mirror, dorado Ultrack, Freitas synthetic) and validated embryo-out; every such path was refuted for this window (C11: P(gated scored probe) 0.03-0.2, central -0.001..-0.002). Even 0.97 (top-6) needs that retraining; the top teams publish nothing (browser s.2-s.3).

R2 insertion: in the F1 stack iff b >= a and b scored (tie counts as include: private break-even 0.11-0.20 vs public 0.265, differentiates from x138); b = a - 0.001 => exclude; b <= a - 0.002 => exclude unless a clean gated re-test K1 >= a (branch C). Only #35's config (steal 1, cap 4, frame cap 1, threshold 0.4, alpha 1); no ladder, no grid. R3 no-harm riders (C01, C05, C04; nodes unchanged or coordinates only): adopt if dummy gates pass and public >= previous stack - 0.001; <= -0.002 => remove that rider, never retry it. R4 node-set / fork-count changers (tempfuse, leaf prune, DeepCenter threshold, successor ports, readmit knobs): into F1 only at >= +0.002 over the current F1 candidate; 0..+0.001 (and >= F1 - 0.001) => F2-diverse candidate; <= -0.001 => closed. risks: 1 Runtime cliff (x138 guard at 27,000 s; exp57b insertion ungated; 12 h hard limit): hidden N is uncertain (Data tab ~199 vs latency bound ~120-140 at dummy speed). Mitigation: C01 on every build, latency <= deadline as a per-file eligibility proof (R5), N1 on trigger (R6), guard-free F2. Residual: P(C01 build still degrades) ~0.03-0.05. 2 Silent private-only failure of a NEW stage (exception => whole-dataset fallback, invisible on public if only private clips trigger it). Mitigation: fail-soft wrappers per stage (keep input), loud log counters, dummy gates, F2 on a different stack. 3 Public-embryo overfitting: one embryo, deterministic scores; mitigation R3/R4 thresholds, only mechanistic riders in F1.
